title: Clogfather — Pressure Tarantella
provenance: Original composition and deterministic sample-free synthesis; no borrowed melody, recordings, soundfonts or third-party instrument samples.
production: Synthetic mandolin-like tremolo, reed/accordion-like chords, low brass-like support, kick/snare/tambourine-like percussion. Instrument approximations, not recordings.
composition: New eight-bar syncopated D-minor/harmonic-minor motif, four arranged sections, dominant final bar resolving into first tonic. No Godfather theme reference.
loop_method: Integer bars/beats, circular note tails and room echoes; no fade-to-silence seam.
